free_tier.stated: Free tier storage is 'Free 20 GB + Extra 50 GB, totaling 70 GB' — but the 70 GB is explicitly a Pro benefit ('Upgrade to HyperAI Pro, Unlock More Benefits ... 3.5× more storage: Free 20 GB + Extra 50 GB, totaling 70 GB'). So free is 20 GB, and 70 GB costs $4.99/month.

egress.terms: Not metered on the free tier; storage tiers are the paid dimension (a discounted tier table exists for scalable storage).

tooling: Web console + app.hyper.ai notebooks; no documented S3/CLI blob API found. Storage is attached to notebooks rather than exposed as a bucket.
chaining: 20 GB per account is too small to multiply usefully; 500 accounts per 10 TiB.
limits_note: 20 GB free, 2 vCPU / 4 GB RAM, 2 h max continuous CPU runtime (8 h on Pro), 30 h/month compute on Pro. Storage is workspace-scoped, not bucket-scoped.
reliability_note: Small aggregator-style GPU marketplace; the storage is a notebook side-car, so data tied to a workspace that may be reclaimed.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
